title: Add the ordering edge for declared cross-group dependencies
body:
## Context

The `/work` queue has no ordering notion between groups. Where `groupIssues()` R1 does not union a pair — an R3 `Split: true` marker, or a component larger than `MAX_ISSUES_PER_GROUP` split into singletons — a dependent group dispatches alongside its dependency, and the loser parks at plan with `cross-group-conflict` after an explore + plan dispatch has already been paid for.

The pre-dispatch gate lives in `extension/src/work-queue-overlap.ts` (`groupPathsOverlap`) and is consulted by the worker loop in `extension/src/work-queue.ts`; it keys on `groupIssues()`-extracted path tokens alone, so a pair whose bodies name no file is invisible to it. The reactive plan-time check in `extension/src/work-driver-path-claims.ts` (`checkAndRegisterClaims`) is the safety net for exactly that case, and it is the thing that parks too late.

## Deliverable

Declare the edge from the issue body and let the queue act on it: a dependent group's `runGroup` is not invoked before its dependency group reaches `merged`; a dependency that settles on anything else parks the dependent `dependency-parked:#N` without dispatching it.

## Out of scope

`groupIssues()` R1 union semantics are unchanged — `Depends-on: #N` and the closing keywords keep merging into one group. Ordering is a queue-level concern between groups, never a re-litigation of a merge R1 made deliberately.
